Detailed Results:

Title: SparrowHook 4.8 Workspace Limits
URL: https://docs.sparrowhook.example/4.8/workspace-limits
Content: SparrowHook 4.8 workspace limits: maximum 37 active webhook endpoints per workspace on all plans. Archived endpoints do not count toward the active limit; up to 200 archived endpoint records may be retained per workspace. This is a workspace-wide limit, not a per-project or per-API-key limit.
